messages.content: 經濟狀況對幸福水平有何影響？

function.name: get_happiness_index
function.description: Fetches the happiness index for a given country or area based on data compiled from global surveys. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which to retrieve the happiness index.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve the happiness index.

demographic_group.description: The demographic group for which to retrieve the happiness index. If not specified, the total for all groups will be returned.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "經濟狀況對幸福水平有何影響？" meaning "How does economic condition affect happiness level?" They likely want an explanation. We can provide a general answer: economic conditions influence happiness via income, employment, inequality, etc. We might also provide data: happiness index by country and income group. We could use the function get_happiness_index to fetch data for a specific country and year. But the question is general. We could give a general explanation and maybe provide an example: e.g., in 2022, high-income countries have higher happiness index than low-income. We could fetch data for a specific country like Sweden or Kenya. But the user didn't specify a country. We could ask for clarification or provide a general overview. We can also mention that beyond income, other factors matter: social support, health, freedom, etc. Provide references to World Happiness Report. We can also mention that the relationship is not linear: beyond a certain point, additional income yields diminishing returns. Also inequality matters. Provide some data: e.g., in 2021, the happiness index for high-income group in the US was X, low-income group Y. We can fetch data for US. Let's do that. Use function get_happiness_index for US, year 2021, demographic_group "high income" and "low income". Then we can compare.
